subtitle: Understanding how introductions establish key centers, mood, and musical themes

introduction.title: The Intro: Setting the Musical Stage
introduction.text: Song introductions are like opening scenes in films—they establish the world, set expectations, and draw the audience in. Musically, intros have the crucial job of defining key centers, presenting thematic material, and creating the emotional atmosphere for everything that follows.

cards.title: Motivic Introduction

cards.description: Establishes the groove and rhythmic feel before harmonic content

fields.value: Focuses on temporal organization before pitch organization

cards.title: Tonic Establishment
cards.description: Stable, confident opening that defines harmonic home

fields.label: Harmonic Function
fields.value: Clearly establishes key through strong tonic-dominant relationships

cards.title: Dominant Approach
cards.description: Strong, decisive opening with clear harmonic direction

fields.label: Harmonic Function
fields.value: Creates expectation and resolution to establish tonic

fields.label: Harmonic Function
fields.value: Subdominant to tonic motion, gentler than dominant approach

cards.title: Ambiguous Opening
cards.description: Creates tonal suspense before key confirmation

fields.label: Harmonic Function
fields.value: Begins on relative minor, gradually reveals major tonality

fields.label: Best Used In
fields.value: Pop songs, punk rock, when immediate impact is desired

fields.label: Best Used In
fields.value: Most popular songs, balanced setup without excess

cards.title: Extended (8-16 bars)
cards.description: Full thematic development and atmospheric creation

cards.title: Epic (16+ bars)
cards.description: Extensive mood setting and thematic exploration

fields.label: Best Used In
fields.value: Symphonic music, prog rock, concept albums

cards.title: False Starts
items: Beginning softly or incompletely, then stopping to restart with full impact creates dramatic effect and listener engagement.

cards.title: Gradual Build
items: Starting with minimal elements and gradually adding instruments creates excitement and anticipation for the main song.

cards.title: Tonal Ambiguity
items: Avoiding clear tonic establishment creates mystery and makes the eventual key revelation more satisfying.

cards.title: Motivic Development
items: Presenting a simple musical idea and gradually developing it creates unity and prepares the main thematic content.

cards.title: Musical Elements
items: Key establishment: How is tonic defined?
Harmonic content: What progressions are used?
Thematic material: What motifs are introduced?
Rhythmic character: What groove is established?
Instrumentation: What sonic palette is presented?

cards.title: Functional Analysis
items: Length appropriateness: Does duration fit the song?
Energy level: Does it match the song's character?
Transition quality: How smoothly does it lead to verse?
Interest level: Does it capture attention effectively?
Unity creation: How does it connect to the whole?
